The exact software product **Prompteasy** at the domain **prompteasy.ai** (described as a tool to "Fine-tune GPT in less than 10 minutes" by creating datasets through AI chat) was created and provided by independent developer **Marius Manolachi**. 

### Evidence
* On Product Hunt, Marius Manolachi is credited as the maker/developer of `prompteasy.ai`, stating: *"I made prompteasy to streamline LLM fine-tuning... We take care of building the dataset ready for fine-tuning. You just chat with the AI, download the dataset, and fine-tune gpt."*
* His developer portfolio lists **PromptEasy** as his project ("A platform revolutionizing AI dataset creation") linked to its launch on Product Hunt.
